cells.normalized_text: On Finisher: Consumes x1 Armor Charge. Instantly fully restores Health and Shields.
On Finisher: Consumes x3 or more Armor Charges Grants Void Overshield for a varying duration. Overshield Duration at x3, x4, x5, and x6 Charges: 8 | 10 | 12 | 14 seconds.
On Finisher: Consumes x3 or more Armor Charge. Grants Grenade Ability Energy. x3 = 70% | x4 = 80% | x5 = 90% | x6 = 100%
On Finisher: Consumes x3 or more Armor Charge. Grants Melee Ability Energy. x3 = 70% | x4 = 80% | x5 = 90% | x6 = 100%
On Finisher: Consumes x3 or more Armor Charge. Grants Class Ability Energy. x3 = 70% | x4 = 80% | x5 = 90% | x6 = 100%
On Finisher, while at x0 Armor Charge: Grants x1 Armor Charge.

sources.finding: Confirms 45 HP Void Overshield and duration table; energy rows explicitly apply the selected ability Chunk Energy Scalar.
Empowered Finish added to finisher-mod mutual exclusivity; cannot equip it alongside charge-consuming finisher mods. Specifically discusses Stacks on Stacks combination.
Multiple copies of Empowered Finish should not provide stacking benefits.

4.0.0.1 separates finisher execution from the optional mod benefit/cost; full melee or insufficient Super does not prevent execution. Historical Super costs are not used as current Armor Charge quantities or multi-charge calibration.

rules.healthy: Wounded living recipient, at least one charge; consume one and submit a full ordinary-health heal request. MC health represents ordinary D2 health and shields. Does not repair overshield or Absorption.
rules.bulwark: Consume all if at least three, restore shared 45 HP Void Overshield for 8/10/12/14 seconds for 3/4/5/6 paid stacks. Existing duration profile and MAX remaining policy apply.
rules.ability_energy: Consume all if at least three and current selected ability has missing capacity. Base 0.7/0.8/0.9/1.0 passes through selected recipient CES and normal gain pipeline once.
rules.empowered: Only at zero, request one shared charge with Stacks on Stacks eligibility; independent new completions are not rate limited.
rules.receipt: Shared finite finisher_id set is marked before benefit eligibility; duplicate source copies, mode swaps, rebind and session checkpoints retain consumed identities. Test window is sixty seconds, not an extra proc cooldown.

open_questions: Formal mod sockets, energy costs, loadout legality, acquisition eligibility of standalone generator/non-consumer mods, auto-assembly, HUD, and physical world restart remain incomplete.

Runtime content guard suppresses all six benefits if multiple distinct finisher modes are injected. Duplicate same-kind sources count once. This is an explicit invalid-loadout policy; complete current Manifest conflict categories are not imported.

Full ordinary health or full/missing ability skips payment. Multi-charge policy tests the full usable-account capacity, allowing recharge of a second charge; current original-game per-mod eligibility requires calibration. Historical patch is not a current multi-charge proof.
Bulwark spends to refresh even when full, uses shared MAX remaining duration and restores capacity. Whether the original avoids spending when neither capacity nor duration improves needs calibration.

Payment precedes world reward: rejected/unknown healing keeps payment; unknown results stop without automatic retries. Unknown-result state cannot establish whether the original game refunds known cancelled healing.
Clarity energy percentages are treated as CES-unscaled base, supported by its explicit scalar note; full modern stat/CMS and all ability interactions remain current gain-profile responsibilities.
Selected loadout and charges are read at confirmed completion; mode change during animation follows current sources. Exact original swap and animation policies are not claimed.
